model: v3_clean (100% CC0/CC-BY-4.0) lipsync_student_offline_fp16.onnx (6.55 MB) + lipsync_student_streaming_fp16.onnx (6.54 MB)

flows.name: desktop-light-en-initial-inference
steps: Open studio and wait for v3_clean ONNX WASM Ready
Verify initial EN demo audio (hello_studio.wav) runs automatic WASM inference
Verify 0 horizontal overflow and all 6 export buttons enabled

flows.name: desktop-dark-ja-es-multilingual-rig-scrub
steps: Switch to Japanese demo (/samples/ja_demo.wav) and Indie Rig in dark mode
Scrub timeline mid-speech and verify live cues, visemes, and mouth curves update
Switch to Spanish demo (/samples/es_demo.wav) and verify multilingual inference succeeds

flows.name: mobile-dark-responsive-and-touch-targets
steps: Resize viewport to 390x844 mobile dark layout
Verify overflowX == 0 and all visible interactive controls >= 44px height
